what: Section list in the fixed sidebar — while a section passes the screen center, that row’s underline grows from the left 0 → 100% tied to scroll (no curve), and entering that section darkens the row (aria-current). Leaving the section downward resets the underline to 0, and the underline of a row that turned off fades over .8s. Clicking a row glides to that section in 1.8s (using Lenis if present)

options.at: Screen-height ratio where the zone starts and ends, default .5 (center)
options.dur: Duration when jumping to a row (seconds, Lenis), default 1.8
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Growing underline inside the line (display only if absent)

use: 01 Your area here…
note: Color comes from the consuming CSS via [aria-current] — inactive lines are dimmed

from.where: shared.js · index.html .mc-navi — original initDynamicNav · setupItemLogic: start = Above the section − innerHeight/2, end = below the section − innerHeight/2, scrub true · ease none, 0% on onLeave, item-active on onEnter·onEnterBack, clicking a line runs lenis.scrollTo(section, { duration: 1.8 }), the turned-off line .scroll-loader opacity .8s
